value.rationale: The new result covers the sole unfinished residue class of a named 2023 odd-sum conjecture through a natural 10^9 threshold, increasing reported k coverage from 1000 to 55,555,555, and determines the exact sharp extremal least Zumkeller summand 4288 with a unique maximizing integer. The covering height is mathematically natural and necessarily unbounded across arbitrarily long progressions by finite-offset CRT obstructions, making a sharp finite profile worthwhile beyond a routine counterexample search.
